daLayer.note: Informational. The binding check is FdcVerification on the fork, which validates the Merkle path against a finalized root rather than trusting an off-chain API.

mainnetEquivalentFLR.note: Attestations are requested on divergence, never on a timer. A 15-minute heartbeat would be ~96 requests/day at 20 FLR = 1,920 FLR/day for no new information. This run requested none: the divergence was not attestable.

governance.note: Impossible on mainnet without governance. The fork is the venue precisely because this call is real rather than mocked.

referenceSize.note: collateralFactorMantissa is a governance constant. An oracle moves the USD value of collateral, hence borrow capacity. Reported as effective CF = CF x haircut.

venues.note: The correlated FXRP/stXRP pool — the deepest on Flare — is deliberately not registered here. A rotation is not an exit.

fdc.note: Attested state is one-directional: a proof may only lower capacity. FdcVerification judges authenticity; Herkos judges direction.
